timestamps: Integer UTC epoch milliseconds; knownAt is the observation poll that emitted the update.

markerUpdate.version: Positive per-episode integer, never a global ordinal

episode.route: Observed route assignment; not inferred from marker proximity
episode.segmentStartedAt: First poll of this continuity segment
episode.marker: Physical marker ID; independent of canonical occurrence
episode.entryLowerAt: Previous continuous observation time or null on first sight/break
episode.polls: Observed fixes in this marker episode
episode.movementFixes: Observed coordinate changes during the episode
episode.plateau: {startedAt,lastAt,polls,metres}; raw coordinate held only in private processing state
episode.stationaryNearKnownAt: First poll with a>=15s observed near plateau, else null
episode.evidence: stationary_fix_supported | possible_pass | uncertain; not a boarding claim
episode.exitLowerAt: Last within125m time on observed exit, else null
episode.exitAt: First observed fix beyond125m, else null
episode.censorKnownAt: First poll where discontinuity is known, else null
episode.absenceWitnessAt: Later same-provider same-name fix beyond125m, else null
episode.contended: Whether provider identity was ambiguous in its segment
episode.simultaneousNearMarkers: Sorted marker IDs within75m on THIS observation only; never merged or inherited

phaseAnnotation.episodeId: Physical episode reference; may annotate an update without changing it
phaseAnnotation.supportedLeg: Guard's causal directed-leg certificate where present, or null
phaseAnnotation.markerOccurrences: All marker indices on canonical runtime route

barrierRow.proposedLabel: Unchanged c80ab5f label; not adopted as truth
barrierRow.targetEpisodeIds: Observed-interval identity matches, unmodified by phase
barrierRow.barriers: Every {episodeId,reason,entryKnownByAsOf,stationaryKnownByAsOf}; reasons include open_at_asof, earlier_encounter, censored_without_exit

continuityBreak.episodeIds: All affected marker-specific episode IDs; none deleted from history
